name: MCL Flat Raw-Turn Epoch Two-Speed Lifecycle
hypothesis: The high-cadence flat-epoch resumption signal has independent expectancy only under one causally meaningful combination of raw-turn ownership, pullback structural risk, and V18 profit memory; a discovery-selected semantic owner must transfer unchanged to validation and improve the immutable V18 portfolio.
signal: The exact 890 outcome-blind V27 flat-epoch candidates; no candidate, direction, clock, overlap, or cadence change is allowed.

execution.entry: one matched-suffix MCL contract at the frozen next one-minute open
execution.raw_turn_exit: next one-minute MCL open after the next raw CL turn
execution.clock_or_contract_reset: last continuous MCL close, no reopen
execution.overlap_and_recursion: forbidden; immutable V18 positions always own priority

semantic_laws.pullback_structural_stop: completed pullback MCL low for a long or high for a short, tested before MFE with adverse gap handling
semantic_laws.profit_memory: after a completed one-minute bar establishes 0.5% MFE, protect 25% of running MFE from the next bar with adverse gap handling

discovery_eligibility.directions: up and down positive under primary and stress

selection_law: Among discovery-eligible owners maximize stress PnL/DD, then primary PnL/DD, then stress net, then minimize primary DD. Only that owner may open validation/full outcomes; nonwinner validation remains sealed.
validation_law: The selected fast owner must independently satisfy every discovery eligibility gate on validation.

portfolio_law.period_cohorts: both directions and acceptance/failure positive under primary and stress in discovery and validation

control: After selection only, invert the selected fast owner over identical holds and primary costs; it cannot rescue or select.
if_no_discovery_owner: Reject the complete flat-epoch resumption lifecycle family before validation; do not sweep stops, activation, retention, holds, thresholds, clocks, or costs.
if_development_passes: Preserve as outcome-exposed development only. Missing July-2023 history, unseen prospective evidence, runtime parity, native transport, margin, preview, allocation, restart, and safety remain mandatory before a crown or capital authority.
